issue.body: The App and Router classes should support a `.url_for(name, **kwargs)` method. We'll probably need to finesse our routing a bit here, eg. remove the ability to drop into plain regex, and instead add something like `{username:str}` / `{page_number:int}`. Eventually we'll probably also want to support namespacing eg. `app.url_for('users:create_user', username=foo)` > [!IMPORTANT] > - We're using [Polar.sh](https://polar.sh/encode) so you can upvote and help fund this issue. > - We receive the funding once the issue is completed & confirmed by you. > - Thank you in advance for helping prioritize & fund our backlog.
issue.title: URL Reversing
